FN-4U4TL3I-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 270
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions Sponsor: Representative Matthew Hammett
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/25/2025
House Bill 270 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Department of
Environmental Management (ADEM) Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the
difference in the amount of fees collected from: (1) the $200 annual water well driller's licenses,
provided by current law; and (2) the $1,000 biennial unrestricted water well driller's license,
$500 biennial restricted water well driller's license, and $500 biennial business entity license
provided by this bill.
This bill could further increase receipts to the ADEM Fund by up to $1,000 for each filing fee
collected for water well completion certifications issued pursuant to this bill.
Page 1

FN-4U4TL3I-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 270
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Matthew Hammett
Economic Development
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/17/2025
House Bill 270 as passed the House of Representatives could increase annual receipts to the
Alabama Department of Environmental Management (ADEM) Fund by an estimated maximum
of: (1) $33,000 by increasing the $200 per year water well drillers license fee to a $1,000
biennial unrestricted water well drillers license fee; (2) $50,000 from a $500 biennial restricted
water well drillers license fee; (3) $146,750 from water well completion certificate fees
collected for private wells; (4) $700,000 from water well completion certificate fees collected
for environmental monitoring wells; and (5) $10,000 from water well completion certificate fees
collected for public wells, totaling $939,750 per year.
